item.title: AI in Medicine and Training
item.description:
• Summary: Penn Medicine is integrating artificial intelligence into physician training, while another article examines how AI agents are being used in addiction medicine, highlighting both promise and pitfalls.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, STAT News

item.title: Cell Therapy and Gene Therapy Advances
item.description:
• Summary: Recent advances include Encoded's gene therapy reducing seizures in Dravet syndrome, ASGCT discussions on in vivo CAR-T, functional peptide screening for GPCRs and radiopharma, and a report on building the cell therapy future from MSCs to iPSCs.
  • MoAs: Gene therapy (AAV-mediated), CAR‑T cell therapy, functional peptide screening, iPSC‑derived cell therapy
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Endpoints News, BioSpace, BioSpace
